scoring.route: omp eval judge_batch with modelRoles.judge typesafe/jev-1.14.0 (direct TypeSafe); per-question scoring runs are recorded in each decision's measured block
scoring.note: same_thing scored 2026-11-23 (k3), consumer_placement 2026-11-23 (k3) and 2026-11-24 (k5 full history), technical_kind_grouping 2026-11-23 (k4) and 2026-11-24 (full history)

rekey: 2026-11-25 (plan step S7a): questions.json lost the unused state.unit_state, which fed every version key. The questions are unchanged, and the registry sends the judge only the questions with states the guardrails proposers build, never the state description, so the judge input is byte-identical: labels.jsonl, scores.csv and the questions/ files moved to the new keys with their labels and scores unchanged, and scores_sha256 pins the rekeyed scores.csv

minimums.reason: jev-actions usefulness floor; technical_kind_grouping and consumer_placement run in shadow because precision cannot be measured yet

questions.technical_kind_grouping: 49 labelled real files (26 history-point, 23 full-history), 0 violations; 40 synthetic
questions.consumer_placement: 30 labelled real files (15 history-point, 15 full-history), 2 violations; 40 synthetic

shortfalls: probabilities are raw, not calibrated confidence

technical_kind_grouping.score: P(true) of the own_capability question for one code-proposed file in a technical-kind folder
technical_kind_grouping.state: {file: {path, docstring, symbols}, folder, importers: up to 3 {path, import}}, built by guardrails kind-candidates
technical_kind_grouping.unit_rule: one candidate file; real cases group by repository

shadow.reason: No real violation among the 26 candidates at 4 history points nor among 44 more from full first-parent history, so precision cannot be measured. At 0.8 it flags 2 of 26 real clean files and catches 7 of 20 planted synthetic violations, with 1 of 20 planted clean cases flagged.

measured.labels: innovation council labels (k4 for the 26 history-point and 40 synthetic files, k5 for 23 full-history files)

shortfalls: no real violation is labelled yet, so precision is unmeasured; shadow until 10 labelled flags
probabilities are raw, not calibrated confidence

same_thing.score: proposer_score * mean P(true): the same_thing answer for one code-proposed name pair asked in both orders (first and second swapped), averaged, times the proposer's proposer_score = 0.5 * name_sim + 0.5 * body_sim
same_thing.state: {first, second}, each {name, kind, path, definition: {signature, docstring, code: first 30 lines}, uses: up to 3 one-line use sites}, built by guardrails name-pairs
same_thing.unit_rule: repository: every pair from one repository shares a unit, so cross-validation folds leave whole repositories out

precision_target.reason: jev-actions usefulness floor: a false finding blocks a PR

same_thing.starting_cutoff: 0.051143, the highest-recall cutoff with in-sample precision >= 0.75 over all 160 labelled real pairs

label_set.labels: innovation council labels, with the Claude arbiter's label for the 5 real and 1 synthetic split pairs
label_set.files: cases.jsonl, labels.jsonl, scores.csv rows with question_id same_thing

consumer_placement.state: {file: {path, first_60_lines, imports}, package: {name, description: first line of the top package's __init__ docstring, omitted when empty}}, built by guardrails consumer-candidates
consumer_placement.unit_rule: one candidate file; real cases group by repository

shadow.reason: At 0.8 the 30 labelled real files gave 4 flags with 1 correct before the proposer fix: too few flags to measure precision.

folder_name_coverage.reason: Cannot find the violations that exist: 160 labelled files across 8 of the owner's repositories hold 5 real violations. The best code score catches all 5 only by flagging 45 files at its default cutoff (5 correct), and the Jev question flags 4 files with none correct and catches 4 of 20 planted synthetic violations. Neither finds the real violations without burying them.
folder_name_coverage.replacement: Guidance only: 'A name covers everything its folder holds' in structure-and-naming.md

sibling_naming_pattern.reason: Cannot find the violations that exist: 10 labelled cases hold 1 real violation. The Jev question flags 8 of 10 at cutoff 0.8, all wrong, misses the real one, and catches 7 of 20 planted synthetic violations.
sibling_naming_pattern.replacement: Guidance only: 'A new folder follows the pattern its same-role peers under one parent share' in structure-and-naming.md

prefix_should_be_folder.reason: Deterministic code meets the target: the cluster score reached leave-one-repository-out precision 44/55 = 0.80 (recall 44/47) on 63 labelled clusters, while the Jev question alone reached 46/60 = 0.77 against 47/63 = 0.75 for flagging every cluster, so Jev added nothing; a judgment that code can meet is deterministic only.
